_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.

cases.scenario: A user asks for work that is near content-monitor but is explicitly outside its declared scope.
cases.context: This is a boundary test. The skill should avoid false-positive activation and route to the better owner when appropriate.
cases.question: Should content-monitor be applied here? If not, what should happen instead?
expected_flags: Recognizes the request is outside content-monitor's ownership
Routes the work to seo-strategy or asks for the missing owner instead of forcing this skill
Preserves any real issue in the request without applying content-monitor terminology incorrectly
expected_fix_hints: Decline to apply content-monitor as the primary skill
Name the better owner or the boundary reason
Offer only a narrow handoff if content-monitor has a secondary support role
absent_signals: Does not claim content-monitor should own the request
Does not use content-monitor's framework to solve an explicitly excluded problem
Does not suppress the correct adjacent owner
